title: OpenAPI specs do not include security schemes for registered APIs
description: The OpenAPI specification downloaded for the test API contains no security schemes, making it unclear to agents what authentication is required. This information gap forces agents to rely on other sources or trial-and-error.
reproduction_steps: Run: jentic apis spec jentic-test/test-api/1.0.0 > spec.json
Examine the spec for security schemes
expected_behavior: The OpenAPI spec should include security schemes that document the authentication requirements for the API, or the platform should inject this information when serving specs.
actual_behavior: No security schemes are defined in the spec, and auth shows as null in operation inspection output.
evidence: Agent observed no security schemes defined in OpenAPI spec, explaining why auth was null in inspect output
The inspect shows the operation but `"auth":null` - no authentication details visible in the operation schema
